name: app-select
title: App Select
description: SealAI product single and multi-select controls for forms, filters, and settings surfaces

files.content:
/**
 * Shared frosted popup surface for dropdown-style popups.
 *
 * Defined once so the Base UI Combobox popups behind `AppSelect`/`AppMultiSelect`
 * and the shared `DropdownMenu` surface stay visually in sync instead of each
 * copy-pasting the `bg-input/30 backdrop-blur-xl` panel. Surface only — item/row
 * highlight stays per-component because the primitives expose different state
 * data-attributes.
 */
export const popoverSurfaceClass =
  "rounded-md border border-border bg-input/30 shadow-none ring-0 backdrop-blur-xl";
